importExport.description: Upload a CSV, map its columns, review, and import.
importExport.dropPrompt: Drop a CSV here, or click to browse
importExport.uploadHint: Up to 5,000 rows · 5MB · .csv · UTF-8 or Shift-JIS
importExport.errorEncoding: We couldn't read this file's text correctly. Save it as a UTF-8 CSV and try again. No records were imported.
importExport.errorNoColumns: No columns found in this file.
importExport.errorNoRows: No data rows found in this file.
importExport.errorTooManyRows: This file has {count} rows; the limit is {max}. Split it into smaller files.
importExport.errorParse: Couldn't read this file. Make sure it's a valid CSV.
importExport.errorPreview: Couldn't analyze the import. Please try again.
importExport.errorImport: The import failed. Please try again.
importExport.errorExport: The export failed. Please try again.
importExport.reviewStale: Your file, mappings or review choices changed. Refresh the review before importing.
importExport.dealDateHint: Closed at and Created at accept yyyy-MM-dd, yyyy/MM/dd or ISO instants. Dates without a time use midnight in the workspace reporting timezone. Without Created at, new deals use import time.
importExport.missingCloseDates: {count, plural, one {# closed deal row has no close date. Its close date will use import time.} other {# closed deal rows have no close date. Their close dates will use import time.}}
importExport.rowUsesImportTime: Closed at will use import time.
importExport.futureCloseDate: Warning: this closed deal has a future close date.
importExport.mapHint: {mapped} of {total} columns mapped. Name is required.
importExport.mapPersonHint: {mapped} of {total} columns mapped. Map a full name or given and family name columns.
importExport.mappingSuggestionHint: Only known headers are suggested. Check the mappings and choose a field for any other columns you want to import.
importExport.nameCompositionHint: Selected name parts become one name, separated by a space. A full-name column is kept as supplied.
importExport.nameMappingConflict: Choose one full-name column or one column for each name part. Set the extra name columns to Ignore before continuing.
importExport.onMatch: When a row matches an existing record
importExport.rowMergeRepresentative: Will combine {count} source rows into one record.
importExport.rowMergeContributor: Will merge into row #{row} before references are created.
importExport.reviewLinkHint: Showing {shown} of {total} actionable rows, including all {candidates} rows with possible matches. Use Link to resolve another record.
importExport.companyVariantNeedsReview: An existing company has a similar name. Choose the intended company and refresh the review, or skip this row.

history.title: Import interaction history
history.description: Bring past activities, notes, or tasks into the relationship timeline.
history.dropPrompt: Drop a CSV here, or click to browse
history.uploadHint: Up to 5,000 rows · 5MB · .csv · UTF-8 or Shift-JIS

errors.noColumns: No columns were found in this file.
errors.noRows: No data rows were found in this file.
errors.tooManyRows: This file has {count} rows. Split it into files of 5,000 rows or fewer.
errors.parse: This CSV could not be read.
errors.preview: The history import could not be analyzed.
errors.commit: The history import could not be completed.

history.mapReady: Required fields are mapped. Every row will still be validated on the server.
history.mapRequired: Map the required fields and at least one participant identity.
history.stale: A participant link changed. Refresh the review before importing.
history.failed: {count, plural, one {# row needs attention} other {# rows need attention}}

importExport.customFieldsFailed: Couldn't load existing custom fields. Retry before mapping custom values.
importExport.duplicateMapping: Several columns use this field. Keep one and set the others to Ignore.
importExport.reuseCustomField: The existing field with this label and type will be used. You can select it directly above.
importExport.reviewTotal: All {count} source rows are available below, including skipped and combined rows.
importExport.reviewEmpty: No rows match this filter. Choose another filter to continue.
importExport.editRowHint: Edit file values here. Refresh the review after editing. Blank optional values are omitted.
importExport.companyChoiceHint: Names alone do not select a company. Choose a visible record, then refresh the review. Skip the row if none is suitable.
importExport.bulkCompanyReview: Use {name} for {count} rows with this company name? Only rows showing this company as a candidate are included. Refresh the review after applying.

failures.CUSTOM_COLLISION: Two columns would use the same custom field. Go back to Map, keep one target and ignore the other column.
failures.CUSTOM_CONFLICT: A custom field conflicts with an existing field. Go back to Map and select the intended existing field or ignore that column.
failures.MAPPING_DUPLICATE: Several columns use the same field. Go back to Map and keep one column per field.
failures.PARTICIPANT_AMBIGUOUS: Several contacts use a participant email. Go back to Map and ignore Contacts, or correct the participant values and review again.
failures.ROW_CHOICE_INVALID: A row choice is outside this file. Clear the row choices or upload the file again.
failures.REVIEW_CHANGED: The review expired or records changed since review. Refresh the review, check the current choices and import again.
failures.PERMISSION: Your permissions do not allow this import. Ask a workspace administrator to check access. Your file and choices are kept here.
failures.RATE_LIMIT: Too many import reviews were requested. Wait a moment, then refresh the review.
failures.INVALID_REQUEST: These mappings or values could not be accepted. Go back to Map to check targets, or correct or skip affected rows and review again.
failures.UNAVAILABLE: Couldn't confirm the import result. Check the records before retrying to avoid importing twice. Your file and choices are kept here; a retry needs a fresh review.
failures.REVIEW_TOO_LARGE: There are too many rows or possible matches to review safely. Go back and upload a smaller file, or refine the identifying values before trying again.
failures.CUSTOM_UNAVAILABLE: A mapped custom field is no longer available. Go back to Map, select an active field or ignore that column, then review again.

problems.NAME_REQUIRED: Enter a name, or skip this row.
problems.NAME_TOO_LONG: Shorten the name to 255 characters or fewer, or skip this row.
problems.EMAIL_INVALID: Correct the email address, leave it blank, or skip this row.
problems.DATE_INVALID: Use YYYY-MM-DD for the expected close date, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CLOSED_AT_INVALID: Use YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD or an ISO instant for Closed at (years 1000–9999), clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CREATED_AT_INVALID: Use YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY/MM/DD or an ISO instant for Created at (years 1000–9999), clear it, or skip this row.
problems.VALUE_INVALID: Enter a valid deal amount within the supported range, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.LINE_ITEMS_CONFLICT: This deal has line items. Remove the amount or currency mapping, update the line items on the deal, or skip this row.
problems.STAGE_UNKNOWN: Correct the pipeline and stage to existing names, or skip this row.
problems.COMPANY_TRUNCATED: There are too many company candidates to review safely. Refine the company name, split the file, or skip this row.
problems.COMPANY_CHOICE_REQUIRED: Choose the intended company below and refresh the review, or skip this row.
problems.COMPANY_CHOICE_UNAVAILABLE: The chosen company is no longer a visible candidate. Choose a current candidate and review again, or skip this row.
problems.COMPANY_CHOICES_CONFLICT: Combined rows choose different companies. Give them the same explicit choice or skip conflicting rows, then review again.
problems.COMPANY_NAME_INVALID: Correct or clear the company name, or skip this row.
problems.CANDIDATES_TRUNCATED: There are too many matches. Use Link to select an owned record if appropriate, refine the values, split the file, or skip this row.
problems.TARGET_UNAVAILABLE: The selected record is unavailable. Remove the link and choose another record, or skip this row.
problems.IDENTITY_CHANGED: A matching email, phone or domain changed after review. Review the current matches again, or skip this row.
problems.SHARED_IDENTITY: A shared record uses this email, phone or domain. Review it and correct the values or skip this row.
problems.IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Emails, phones or domains point to conflicting records or file rows. Use Link to choose the intended owned record, correct values, or skip conflicting rows. No row wins automatically.
problems.DEAL_CHOICE_REQUIRED: Several deals have this name and company. Use Link to select the intended deal, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_NUMBER: Enter a number for “{field}”, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_RANGE: Reduce the value for “{field}”, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_DATE: Use YYYY-MM-DD for “{field}”, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_BOOLEAN: Use true or false for “{field}”, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_URL: Enter a valid URL for “{field}”, clear it, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_INVALID: Check or clear the value for “{field}”, or skip this row.
problems.ROW_INVALID: Check the mapped values, correct or skip this row, then refresh the review.
problems.CUSTOM_REQUIRED: Enter a value for the required field “{field}”, or skip this row.
problems.CUSTOM_OPTION: Choose an allowed option for “{field}”, clear it if optional, or skip this row.
problems.COMPANY_VARIANT_CHOICE_REQUIRED: An existing company has a similar name. Choose the intended company and refresh the review, or skip this row.
problems.CURRENCY_INVALID: The currency is not supported. Enter a supported three-letter currency code such as JPY or USD, then review again or skip this row.

importExport.unavailableCustomFieldHint: This field is no longer available. Select an active field or set this column to Ignore.
importExport.currencyInvalid: The currency is not supported. Enter a three-letter currency code such as JPY or USD and import the file again.
